newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in dull late trading on Friday, with most buyers absent from the market in the aftermath of the Moslem Eid al-Fitr and Lunar New Year festivals, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. Crude palm oil was on offer at 1,280-90 rupiah/kg in Medan, against last done 1,270 rupiah.
"There was not much activity in the market today, as most players were still on holiday," one trader said.
Traders said they expected prices to improve next week on the back of fresh demand after the festival lull.
"Buyers should be coming back to the market, after not taking any positions the past week or so," one trader said.
Traders also said crude palm oil supply was tight while its export prices were good, adding that there were no margins in processing crude palm oil into olein for the local market.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Bunga Cendrawasih will leave on Saturday for Pasir Gudang, Malaysia with 10,000 tonnes of palm oil. The Sinar Surya will leave on Saturday for Cirebon with 1,400 tonnes of palm olein.
